texts.en:
Following the destruction of our fleet in the [From.From.From.GetStarName] system, the local Void Cloud appears to have gathered enough material from the debris to undergo what can best be described as a form of mitosis on the macro level - asexual reproduction.

There is now one more Void Cloud haunting [From.From.From.GetStarName].

summary.text:
# 恶臭的后代 / Effluvial Offspring

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/galactic_features_events.txt:774-940`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

虚空云（cloud 类国家）连续摧毁两支舰队时，云的强度达到2，galactic_features.360 以25%×4概率生出一支新的“流出后代”（四种名字之一），并通知有通讯的人类玩家。

When a Void Cloud fleet destroys two fleets its strength reaches 2 and galactic_features.360 spawns a new "Effluvial Offspring" fleet (one of four names, 25% each) and informs human players in contact.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

通知窗口 galactic_features.361，选项依伦理而异（狂热和平者/平衡/军国/排外或终结者/亲外/…/灵性/唯物）。

The notice galactic_features.361 has options by ethic (fanatic pacifist / balanced / militarist / xenophobe or terminator / xenophile / ... / spiritualist / materialist).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无。

None.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

选项因伦理而异。

Options differ by ethic.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了云强度变量与四种子代。

The cloud-strength variable and the four offspring were checked.
